# FFE — The Language of Fashion

> FFE is an interactive fashion literacy game where players decode outfit photos by identifying which descriptive word doesn't belong to the outfit's style language. Think of it as a "spot the odd one out" game built around fashion aesthetics. Available in Russian (default) and English.

## What is FFE?

Each outfit is a code across five layers — form, detail, colour, meaning, associations. Four words describe the outfit; one is an intruder from a different style language. Find it to crack the code.

The game builds the ability to read and articulate what an outfit communicates — actively, layer by layer, without theory.

## Pages

- [Gallery](https://ffe-blush.vercel.app/): Browse the full collection of outfit photos available to decode
- [Outfit game](https://ffe-blush.vercel.app/outfit/[id]): Play the decoding game for a specific outfit — find the word that doesn't belong

## Languages

- Russian (`/`) — default language
- English (`/en`) — English version of all pages

## Key concepts

- **Fashion language** (язык моды): the idea that every outfit communicates meaning through a consistent visual and stylistic code
- **Decoding an outfit**: identifying the dominant aesthetic of a look by understanding which elements are coherent and which create dissonance
- **Style layers**: each outfit is analysed across multiple stylistic dimensions (silhouette, mood, occasion, etc.)

## Content

FFE features curated outfit photography analysed by AI to generate style word sets. Outfits span a range of aesthetics including minimalism, romanticism, streetwear, classic, avant-garde, and more.

## Intended audience

People interested in fashion, personal style development, styling education, and fashion aesthetics — primarily Russian-speaking users, with an English-speaking audience.
